title: Equation Ledger Wave 003 — Applied Systems, Boundaries, Branching, Compression and Celestial Measurement
status: canonical companion ledger to the root equation registry
purpose: Register the September 11 applied-science equations introduced after the core measurement architecture: Merkaba/counter-rotation, Garden/Farm control, Spudlight measurement, celestial Axis, Tree/provenance, Mountain/compression and House/Shell boundaries. Each entry names equation role, domain and failure boundary so the formulas cannot drift into cross-domain literalism.

entries.derived: sin(delta*)=omega_0/K; locking requires |omega_0|<=|K| in this symmetric toy model
entries.use: Distinguish stationary mean/center from active relative dynamics.
entries.boundary: Not a recovered Tim equation or physical Merkaba law.

entries.use: Shows an in-phase order parameter can misclassify organized opposition as disorder.
entries.boundary: Choose order parameter from the intended relation; no universal integration scalar follows.

entries.derived: For I_1=I_2=I and omega_2=-omega_1, L_z=0 but E_rot=I omega_1^2>0.
entries.use: Zero net signed/angular quantity does not imply zero motion or energy.

entries.variables: k capability; r resources; W relational weights; u intervention; delta decay; e extraction/burden
entries.use: Separate internal capability growth, relational support, intervention, decay and extraction.

entries.range: not intrinsically bounded if removal unexpectedly improves performance; interpretation must declare baseline
entries.use: Measure what capability remains after central/support node removal instead of equating activity with autonomy.
Autonomy-weighted durable capability gain distributed within graph radius R of a center.
entries.boundary: One candidate operationalization; not a measure of divinity or moral worth.

entries.use: Prefer Pareto comparison before hidden weighted scalarization.

equations: N_obs~Poisson(eta Ndot_gamma Delta t+b Delta t)
entries.variables: eta detection efficiency; b background rate; Delta t exposure
entries.use: Separate physical source photon rate from detector observations/noise.
Treat mediation/reflection/channel as an operator with noise rather than as inherently true/false.
Quantify update/evidential discrimination separately from attention or optical brightness.
Model attention as source input plus feedback minus decay; high attention does not imply truth.

entries.stability: self-decay dominates in the linear model when max Re eig(-gamma I+beta W)<0
entries.use: Separate source strength from network feedback/amplification.

entries.equation: n(alpha,delta)=(cos delta cos alpha,cos delta sin alpha,sin delta)
entries.units: alpha,delta radians inside trigonometric functions; n dimensionless
entries.use: Turn RA/Dec into a vector for physical alignment tests.

equations: cos psi=sin delta_1 sin delta_2+cos delta_1 cos delta_2 cos(alpha_1-alpha_2)
psi_axis=acos(|a dot n|) for undirected axis
entries.use: Quantify alignment residual instead of drawing lines by eye.

entries.objective: maximize sum_i w_i(a dot n_i)^2 subject to |a|=1
entries.use: Estimate one undirected axis from a predeclared target set.
Assess angular proximity to a pre-specified target/axis before correcting for search multiplicity.

entries.equation: sin h=sin phi sin delta+cos phi cos delta cos H
entries.variables: phi observer latitude; delta target declination; H hour angle; h altitude
entries.use: Shows local pointing claims require observer location and time.
Demonstrates that one remembered length does not identify a two-radius torus.
Baseline for proliferation; m>1 means expected growth, not truth/usefulness.
Distinguish a balanced set of substantive branches from one dominant branch plus trivial twigs.

equations: d_source(v)=minimum verified hops to primary source
entries.use: Measure whether branching remains auditable to roots.
Model relevant compression: reduce retained detail about X while preserving task-relevant information about Y under this convention.
entries.boundary: Project Mountain is symbolic unless X,Z,Y are actual modeled variables.

entries.use: Compression quality requires reconstruction/task/provenance measures, not compression ratio alone.
Quantify information lost across one abstraction level for declared reconstructible components.

entries.equation: X_I conditionally independent of X_E given X_B when X_B is a valid Markov blanket
entries.use: Boundary can mediate relation while statistically insulating internal/external states.
Represent typed cross-boundary flow when domain-specific units and linear approximation are valid.
Measure network bottleneck/modularity; value is not moral valence.

equations: P_i=portable capability after exit/eligible capability before exit
entries.use: Distinguish protective enclosure from capture through actual exit and retained capability.

integration_rules: Every wave-003 equation must be linked to a canonical concept owner through knowledge/indexes/scientific-concept-crosswalk.json.
Metrics of activity, centrality, connectivity or proliferation must not be treated as measures of truth, goodness or spiritual rank.
Negative scientific results are valid outputs and should remain visible.
Where a project symbol maps to several scientific models, choose the model by the question being asked rather than combining equations across incompatible units/domains.
